mathematics.assertion_tested: The prescribed compact source is not a linear perturbation of the specified empty-particle, radial-electrovac background. The exact cylinder is not a background in the original compact-leaf domain.
mathematics.conventions: signature -+++; rho is orthonormal density; x is proper cylinder distance

bounds.sector: linear spherical electric Maxwell, empty particle background, smooth compact spatial source

non_claims: positive material realization of the external source

checks.name: external source satisfies both conservation identities
spherical source-free Maxwell reduces to constant flux
fixed Maxwell charge has only the already included area response

evidence.additional_compact_flux: delta Q=0 by space/time constancy and compact support

checks.name: constructed additional density has exactly zero spatial integral
checks.evidence: Integral rho dx=[2(-B third derivative+a^2 B first derivative)] at both compact-support endpoints=0.

checks.name: density is nonzero and signed at an exact illustrative acceleration

evidence.interpretation: At a=2 center>0; zero integral forces negative density somewhere. General branch condition is given by center expression.

checks.name: signed-density argument is independent of numerical background a
checks.evidence: Integration by parts: integral Z(-Z_xx+a^2 Z)=integral (Z_x)^2+a^2 Z^2>0 for nonzero compact Z; rho cannot vanish identically.

checks.name: compact source has exactly zero Killing energy
checks.evidence: Integral e^(ax) rho_s dx is the endpoint value of 2e^(ax)(aZ-Z_x), hence zero for any compact smooth Z. Positive particle additions have strictly positive Killing energy.

checks.name: Killing energy negative control detects an added nonconserved density
independent quadrature retains signed density and zero Killing energy
the affine cylinder cannot be periodically identified as this scalar/lapse background

evidence.general_obstruction: Every smooth real scalar U on a compact closed leaf attains extrema, where DU=0; the globally constant nonzero-gradient cylinder is outside that domain.

residual_risks: Positive-mass particle additions about zero particle density; linear spherical Maxwell; same exact background and original compact-domain specification. Differences about nonzero particle backgrounds, nonspherical matter, and full constrained retarded responses remain untested.
